test_title: PYST 48 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Which sentence contains a misspelled word?

options.text: Clear communication is crucial for avoiding misunderstandings in any negotiation.
It is cruicial to double-check your work before submitting it.
The manager highlighted the crucial role of teamwork in achieving success.
Meeting the deadline was crucial for securing the contract.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. It is cruicial to double-check your work before submitting it.
